consolidatedTrackers.note: Per-lane children closed 2026-07-05; detailed execution truth stays in this hub. PRD-687 is the canonical plan-hub parent mirror because plan-hub supports one parent issue; PRD-691 remains the active September needs app tracker.

notes: Vocabulary is Need, never problem — code and copy alike (decision #1).
Four EAS schemas (Need, NeedSignal, NeedStatus, FundingAttribution); commitments stay module-native (CP decision-register addendum #28).
EAS is never indexed by Envio: status derivation is an app-side join of easscan reads and Envio commitment entities carrying needUID.
Operator moderation is NeedStatus states, never EAS revocation (attester-only); Need/NeedSignal revocability grants only self-retraction/un-signal.
The needUID commitment field was amended into the CP contract-spec on 2026-07-04, before the August build, so it ships in the initial deploy.
No claim flow, no leaderboards, no funding-ranked boards, no per-need escrow, no push notifications; the gathering is the notification layer.
status.json is authoritative; branch names are automation signals.
.plans/ is the durable repo truth; the Linear project mirrors this hub 1:1.
